instruction: Candid cinematic full shot of a cozy bedroom where an elderly couple dances. On the left, the elderly woman with glasses (R2) stands barefoot in a white shirt and light trousers, smiling warmly at her partner. On the right, the elderly bald man (R1) in a striped shirt and khaki pants stands with his back-three-quarters to the camera, dancing. They face each other on a dark patterned rug, gesturing playfully. Warm, soft indoor lighting illuminates the scene, highlighting the rich red and blue tones of the rug and the neutral curtains in the background.
